# Juan Esteban Camargo

> Juan Esteban Camargo is a Colombia-based Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience building web platforms end-to-end. His work focuses on JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue.js, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, web performance, technical SEO, local SEO, GEO/AEO, and AI-assisted software workflows.
